zh.title: 華航前3季營收、淨利創歷年同期新高 每股盈餘1.8元
zh.summary: 華航公佈前3季財報，營收與淨利創歷年同期新高，每股盈餘1.8元。
body: 中華航空公告今年前3季財報，合併營收新臺幣1859.4億元，合併稅後淨利126.24億元，歸屬母公司淨利110.02億元，每股盈餘（EPS）1.8元；前3季營收及淨利雙創歷年同期新高。第3季營收651.25億元、淨利49.29億元及EPS 0.72元，也寫下歷年同期新高。
客運方面，華航指出，受惠今年暑期旅遊旺季需求，前3季及第3季客運營收均創歷年新高；前3季客運收入1067.86億元，年增14.35%，第3季客運收入365.42億元，年成長22.4%。
貨運方面，華航前3季貨運收入629.08億元，年增29.16%，主要受AI伺服器、半導體機臺等高附加價值貨源持續暢旺帶動。華航表示，貨運需求穩健成長，市場量價齊揚；第3季貨運營收227.29億元，較去年同期成長37.47%。

en.title: China Airlines reports record first-three-quarter revenue and net profit, EPS at NT$1.8
en.summary: China Airlines reports record first-three-quarter revenue and net profit, with EPS of NT$1.8.
body: China Airlines said revenue and net profit for the first three quarters both set records for the same period, with EPS of NT$1.8. Third-quarter revenue, net profit and EPS also reached same-period highs; EPS was NT$0.72.

Passenger revenue rose 14.35% year on year in the first three quarters and 22.4% in the third quarter. The airline said demand during this year's summer travel peak helped passenger revenue set records in both periods.

First-three-quarter cargo revenue rose 29.16% year on year. China Airlines attributed the increase mainly to sustained strength in high-value cargo, including AI servers and semiconductor equipment. It said cargo demand was growing steadily, with market volume and prices rising; third-quarter cargo revenue increased 37.47% year on year.
